Hi David — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my portfolio. I’m very interested in this fintech compliance dashboard project. The tech stack and core features you outlined are right in my wheelhouse.

A few quick questions to make sure I can hit your timeline and scope:
• Can you confirm whether the $8,000 is a fixed-price for the full 6-week scope, and whether there’s any flexibility for scope creep or change requests? 
• Will you provide example data or a sandbox API for the real-time transaction monitoring, or should I build a mock ingestion pipeline initially? 
• What are the security/compliance requirements (SOC2, PCI scope, data encryption/PII handling) I should plan for? 
• I see links for an NDA and onboarding in the thread — I’m happy to sign an NDA. Before I do, could you confirm the company domain for NexGen and the contact for onboarding? 

I’m available for a quick 20–30 minute call this week to align on scope and next steps; otherwise I can start next Monday if we’re aligned. Looking forward to hearing more. — Jordan
